QUOTE: "**How many automatic retries: zero.** The client has a default of 3 exponential-backoff retries (`app/managers/network_manager.ts`, lines 68–71). But `app/client/rest/posts.ts` (line 46) sends `createPost` with `noRetry: true`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that createPost is never automatically retried (zero retries, noRetry: true, retryLimit: 0), so the request is sent once.
